notes.title: Commander '85 - Update #5
notes.content:
The next update is here! We have fixed the most common issue, and improved the title. We hope that these changes will improve your experience, and allow you to enjoy the game even more!

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Gamepad support has been improved, and should work as intended. Please remember, that due to the lack of specific keys on some game controllers, some functions in the game may be available under different keys.
[/list]

If you encounter a different bug, or an issue you believe should be fixed, please drop me an e-mail (martin@themoonwalls.com), and I will update the game as soon as possible.

tags.bug: Gamepad support has been improved, and should work as intended.
